user_stories.goal: Enter a location with autosuggest and generate a horror story with an image in one click.
user_stories.benefit: I quickly get a location-themed story and matching visual without friction.
acceptance_criteria: When I type 3+ characters, the location field shows up to 5 geocoding suggestions.
When I select a suggestion and click Generate, the system returns story text, image URL, and generation ID.

user_stories.goal: Choose story length and tone presets before generating the story and image.
user_stories.benefit: I can produce content that fits my audience and publishing format.
acceptance_criteria: When I select a length preset and tone preset, the generation request includes the chosen length and tone values.
When generation completes, the displayed story word count is within 10% of the selected preset.

user_stories.goal: Copy the story, download the image, and share a link from the results page.
user_stories.benefit: I can easily reuse or share the generated content.
acceptance_criteria: When I click Copy Text, the full story is placed into the clipboard.
When I click Download Image and choose 1024×1024 or 2048×2048, a PNG file downloads at the selected resolution when available.

user_stories.goal: Report unsafe or inappropriate generated content from the results page.
user_stories.benefit: I help keep the platform safe and improve output quality.
acceptance_criteria: When I click Report, I can select a reason, enter optional notes, and submit the report.
Upon submission, the report is stored with the generation ID, timestamp, and hashed IP identifier.

user_stories.goal: Review logs and reports, then hide/delete content, block triggers, or regenerate in safe mode.
user_stories.benefit: I can quickly mitigate policy violations and prevent repeat issues.
acceptance_criteria: When I search by generation ID in the admin dashboard, I can view prompt, outputs, and metadata for that generation.
When I click Hide, Delete, Block, or Regenerate Safe Mode, the system applies the action and records an audit log entry.
